import os, re, shutil
from pathlib import Path

src = Path("gelen")
dst_root = Path("arsiv")
media_exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".mp4", ".mov"}

# first YYYYMMDD starting with 20 -> 20XXXXXX (8 digits) or YYYY-MM-DD
pat_compact = re.compile(r"20\d{6}")
pat_dashed = re.compile(r"(20\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})")

moved = []
for p in sorted(src.rglob("*")):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    if p.suffix.lower() not in media_exts:
        continue
    name = p.name
    m1 = pat_compact.search(name)
    m2 = pat_dashed.search(name)
    matches = []
    if m1:
        s, e = m1.span()
        # ensure it's exactly 8 digits not part of longer digit run? spec: first YYYYMMDD (8 digits starting with 20)
        matches.append((s, "compact", m1.group()))
    if m2:
        s, e = m2.span(1), m2.end()
        matches.append((m2.start(), "dashed", m2.group()))
    date_str = None
    if matches:
        matches.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        _, kind, val = matches[0]
        if kind == "compact":
            d = val[4:]  # wait compact is 8 digits: YYYYMMDD -> group() length 8? 20\d{6} => total 8 chars yes
            date_str = f"{val[:4]}/{val[4:6]}/{val[6:8]}"
        else:
            date_str = val.replace("-", "/")
    if date_str is None:
        dest_dir = dst_root / "tarihsiz"
    else:
        parts = date_str.split("/")
        dest_dir = dst_root.joinpath(*parts)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / name
    shutil.move(str(p), str(dest))
    moved.append((str(p), str(dest)))

for m in moved:
    print(m[0], "->", m[1])
print("TOPLAM:", len(moved))

args.code:
import os, re
from pathlib import Path

src = Path("gelen")
media_exts = {".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".mp4", ".mov"}
pat_compact = re.compile(r"20\d{6}")
pat_dashed = re.compile(r"(20\d{2})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})")

for p in sorted(src.rglob("*")):
    if not p.is_file() or p.suffix.lower() not in media_exts:
        continue
    name = p.name
    m1, m2 = pat_compact.search(name), pat_dashed.search(name)
    matches = []
    if m1:
        matches.append((m1.start(), "c", m1.group()))
    if m2:
        matches.append((m2.start(), "d", m2.group()))
    date_str = None
    if matches:
        _, kind, val = sorted(matches)[0]
        date_str = f"{val[:4]}/{val[4:6]}/{val[6:8]}" if kind == "c" else val.replace("-", "/")
    dest_dir = Path("arsiv", *date_str.split("/")) if date_str else Path("arsiv/tarihsiz")
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    os.rename(str(p), str(dest_dir / name))
    print(f"{p} -> {dest_dir / name}")

print("--- kalan dosyalar ---")
for p in sorted(Path("gelen").rglob("*")):
    if p.is_file():
        print(p)
